mapper.update: UPDATE budget_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},active_report_id=#{reportId},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND command_digest=#{digest}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM budget_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM budget_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{reportId} ORDER BY financial_version DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no FROM budget_operation q LEFT JOIN expense_report e ON e.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND e.id=q.report_id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.id=e.application_id WHERE (q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('EXECUTING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
